fields.headline: Evacuation Order — Inundation Zone A
fields.body: Cedar Ridge Dam operators report a possible dam failure. Residents of Inundation Zone A — City of Milford must leave NOW. Go to high ground east of Route 9. Do not drive through flood water.
fields.areaAffected: Inundation Zone A — City of Milford
instructions: Leave now by Route 9 eastbound or Ridge Road
Take medications, pets and phone chargers
Shelter open: Milford High School, 400 Ridge Rd
